name: Ivan Ponce
summary: Senior Python backend engineer with 11+ years of experience building scalable systems across fintech, healthtech, and edtech. Currently designing production AI infrastructure — LLM-powered chatbots, RAG pipelines, and semantic search — for a health-tech platform serving 120K+ users worldwide.

experience.responsibility: Architecting AI-powered backend infrastructure for a health-tech platform processing wearable data from 60+ device integrations across 170+ countries.
highlights: Designed and implemented an AI-powered Insights Chatbot integrating multiple LLM providers (AWS Bedrock, OpenRouter), enabling natural language interaction with personal health data — launched to 120K+ users in Q1 2026.
Built the full RAG infrastructure: short- and long-term memory management, semantic search, and contextual reasoning over millions of wearable data points.
Developed high-performance data processing pipelines using columnar formats (Parquet) and Polars to efficiently handle large-scale wearable datasets at ingestion and query time.
Incorporated AI-assisted development workflows (Claude, coding agents) to accelerate prototyping, system design exploration, and iterative delivery.

experience.responsibility: Building and maintaining a national-scale student enrollment platform used across multiple U.S. school districts.
highlights: Built and maintained a large-scale enrollment platform connecting students with schools across multiple districts, each with customized admission rules and seat allocation logic.
Developed core platform features including the guardian portal, seat management system, and administrative tools for schools and districts.
Built complementary systems for notifications, event management, and CSM.

experience.responsibility: Building financial analysis and payment processing features for an accounts receivable automation platform.
highlights: Worked with the CashPro team to build a customized cash flow projection product for Bank of America, enabling financial analysts to model and forecast cash positions across client portfolios.
Designed and built the Payments Portal, a production-grade tool processing real financial transactions on behalf of Tesorio's end customers, including full test coverage and QA ownership.
Joined the core product team supporting collections, communications, and payment workflows.

experience.organization: Allstars IT / Fragomen, Del Rey, Bernsen & Loewy
experience.responsibility: Developing backend features for a New York-based immigration case management platform.
highlights: Built backend functionalities for Fragomen's in-house platform as part of the Configuration team, adding support for new migration case types for foreign nationals.
Worked with Python, Django, DRF, and PostgreSQL in a large-scale legal-tech codebase.

experience.responsibility: Managing ERP integrations and customer onboarding for an accounts receivable automation platform.
highlights: Part of the Integrations Team, responsible for syncing financial data between Tesorio and multiple ERP systems (NetSuite, QuickBooks, Sage, etc.) via their APIs — ensuring data consistency for downstream product teams.
Designed and built features for the customer registration and onboarding flow.

experience.responsibility: Leading backend development for a full legacy system rewrite for a Boston-based real estate and property management company.
highlights: Part of a 10+ engineer team that successfully led a full legacy system rewrite over 12+ months, adopting a modern Python/Django stack from the ground up.
Owned design and implementation of key subsystems: user management, authentication, labor & materials tracking, and a configurable rules engine.

experience.responsibility: Building a new version of an insurance and financial services comparison platform for a Colombian startup.
highlights: Built a new version of the system migrating from a legacy stack to Python/Django, DRF, GraphQL, and PostgreSQL.
Designed and implemented authentication flows, funnel logic, rules systems, and notification mechanisms.

experience.responsibility: Building electronic fraud detection features for financial institutions.
highlights: Designed and built features for the DBS Client product, an electronic fraud detection platform for financial institutions.

experience.responsibility: Feature development for a major Colombian bank's loans area.
highlights: Developed features for one of the main banks of Bogotá, working in the loans management area.

experience.responsibility: Co-founded a software development company building solutions for international clients.
highlights: Co-founded a software development company with friends, delivering projects for international clients including a group of churches in the USA.
First professional experience working with Python and Django.
